title: TenancyServiceUpdatedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.service.updated` version 1: a partner's service was registered, enabled, disabled, configured, switched on or off at a location, or repriced, by the partner, by platform staff on its behalf, by a document's approval or by a plan change. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner. Readers ask the registry where the service trades (`GET /v1/partners/{partner_id}/services`) rather than keep a copy; the configuration is not part of the payload. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner that runs the service, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

status.description: The status of the service after the change.

service_id.description: The service, one of possibly several of its kind; absent only on events published before services had ids of their own in events.

previous_status.description: The status before the change, when the change moved it.

pricing_version.description: The pricing version in force, for a delivery service whose pricing changed.
